mu_name_from: MuMain _enum.h MONSTER_ORC_ARCHER (64), drawn as MODEL_ORC_ARCHER = MODEL_MONSTER01 + 46, so OpenMonsterModel loads Monster47.bmd, the body Blood Castle's Chief Skeleton Archer (85, OrcArcher01) wears. OpenMU Version095d Maps/DevilSquare3.cs:85 names breed 64 'Orc Archer'. docs/devil-square-port.md Part B 3.1.
monster_from: ZzzCharacter.cpp:13650-13658, CreateMonster, case MONSTER_ORC_ARCHER: OpenMonsterModel(MONSTER_MODEL_ORC_ARCHER); CreateCharacter(Key, MODEL_ORC_ARCHER, ...); Scale = 1.2f; Weapon[1].Type = MODEL_BATTLE_BOW, Level = 3; o->HiddenMesh = 1. Not drawn as ExtraMon (ZzzCharacter.cpp:8645-8651 lists only the Orc Archer of Doom), so no BodyLight and no RENDER_EXTRA on its bow (:7012).
hidden_mesh_from: `o->HiddenMesh = 1` (ZzzCharacter.cpp:13657). Mesh 1 of Monster47.bmd is kni01, 43 triangles over the top of the head (z 173-215, above kni02's helm), the second of the three groups in the .obj and in `sheets`, which is how clean_lowpoly.kept_apart finds it. The Chief Skeleton Archer keeps it; so this is the same export built a second time with that part kept apart and dropped (see mesh_from).
mesh_from: Its own build of Monster47, not a pointer at OrcArcher01's: OrcArcher02.obj and .rig.json are the same export. OrcArcher01's glb welds its three meshes into one part, so the cook has no `hidden` part on it to drop; a hidden_mesh row needs the weld to keep that mesh apart at build time (clean_lowpoly.kept_apart).
summoned_in_from: Devil Square raises its breeds by the wave (docs/devil-square-port.md 4.2), as Blood Castle raises its castles' breeds: cooked with Devil Square whether or not map 9 has spawn rows yet.
right_hand_from: MODEL_BATTLE_BOW is MODEL_BOW + 3, Item/Bow04.bmd (cooked), as the Chief Skeleton Archer's; MU sets it in Weapon[1], here right_hand because the cook reads the stance off that field. Its bone is CreateCharacter's weapon switch, case MODEL_ORC_ARCHER: Weapon[0].LinkBone = Weapon[1].LinkBone = 39 (ZzzCharacter.cpp:11970-11973), hand_bofdgne01.
rig_from: Seven actions, exported with --actions=all. 40 bones. BoneHead = 7 (ZzzOpenData.cpp:3718-3723).
sheet_from: The Chief Skeleton Warrior's three sheets, which Monster47.bmd names as Monster48 does: kni00 on the body (512 triangles), kni01 (43), kni02 the helm (54). Shared with Orc01, decoded once as orc_*.
sheet_materials_from: As the Chief Skeleton Warrior's (Orc01), which the user passed: gilt bronze plate kept as painted albedo. Then plate_steel, 2026-10-03 (the user: 'skeleton warion metal armors doont look realistical enoguht also they are pretty light'; of Orc01 first, 'its better'): a real metal, half its reflectance taken from the painting, so the plate goes dark steel in its shadows and catches the moon and the lamps on its edges instead of reading as painted plastic; the grain override kept on it.
material_overrides_why: As Orc01's: painted_steel's brushed grain striped the plate (the user: 'kind fo striped?'), so it is all but taken out.
sounds_from: ZzzOpenData.cpp:3718-3723, the model's: mOrcArcherAttack1 and mBullDie, SetMonsterSound(..., -1, -1, 162, 162, 4) -- no walking cry. Wired as orcarcher_* in sounds.json.
islands_from: 12 islands, all painted_steel (see sheet_materials_from). They arrived as skin, the monster profile's default.
plus_from: MU's Level 3 (ZzzCharacter.cpp:13655): the bow drawn at +3.
